## Claims check

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted |
| "most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported** |
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start" | Soft framing of the pause/cancel claim, fine |

## Problem

"Most boxes ship free" is an unsupported claim. It implies that most orders or subscription boxes are over £25, and nothing in the allowlist or this chat supports that. The allowlist only backs the £25 threshold. It says nothing about typical basket size, and it doesn't say whether subscription boxes qualify for free delivery. The line also reads as a statistic, even though it has no number in it.

## Slop check

No ban-list words, em-dash sandwiches, exclamation points, rhetorical openers or fake urgency. The style is clean.

## Suggested compliant version

> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

If you want to say that most boxes ship free, send me the order data and its source, or confirm that subscription boxes qualify, and I'll add it back.
